steps.text: Why physics matters in daily life
Physics is the study of matter and energy. It explains how the world works from the smallest particle to the largest star.
Physics deals with natural phenomena and matter interactions
A resultant force is the single force that has the same effect as all the forces acting together.
Scientific method steps
The scientific method is a systematic way of asking questions and testing ideas.
1. Observation 2. Hypothesis 3. Experiment 4. Conclusion
Branches of physics
Physics is divided into branches. Each branch studies a different type of physical phenomenon.
Mechanics: motion and forces Electricity: flow of charge
Relation of physics to other subjects
Physics provides the foundation for biology, chemistry and other sciences.

Career opportunities in physics
Physics opens doors to many careers. Engineering is the most direct path.
Engineering fields: Civil, Electrical, Mechanical
